description: Defines the LoanSubStatus enum for representing various loan sub-statuses such as invalid, foreclosed, and contract termination, including methods for status conversion and comparison.

classes.name: LoanSubStatus
classes.description: Enumeration of loan sub-statuses with utility methods for status handling.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Converts an integer status value to a LoanSubStatus enum.

methods.name: hasStateOf
methods.description: Checks if the current status matches a given state.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value of the status.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the status.

methods.name: isForeclosed
methods.description: Checks if the status is foreclosed.

methods.name: isContractTermination
methods.description: Checks if the status is contract termination.

methods.name: loanSubStatus
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given status id.

methods.name: loanSubStatusEnum
methods.description: Returns EnumOptionData for a given LoanSubStatus enum.
